features: DIAGNOSIS WITHOUT A CURE — The journal widget could say the balance sheet did not balance, and could even say why («there is a cash account with an unrecorded opening balance»), and then it linked to that account's page, where no button records it. Perfect diagnosis, no cure. The question that opened this version was «how do I fix it? The widget does not tell me what to do», and the verified answer was: there was nothing that could be done. No migration, and no data changes on its own.

NOW THERE IS A BUTTON. In the diagnosis, next to every flagged resource, there is «Register opening»: one click posts the balance to the journal with its counterpart and the imbalance closes. Assets do not change — that liquidity was already there, it simply had no counterpart — and Liabilities rise by the same figure on the Past Management Fund.

AND IT SAYS WHAT IS MISSING WHEN IT CANNOT. The action could fail for five different reasons and reported only one, in a log file nobody opens. Each now has its own message with the way out: no accounting period, no «Past Management Fund» account, the resource has no ledger account. And the two cases that are not errors — zero amount, opening already recorded — are no longer presented as such.

THE HOLE THAT KEPT PRODUCING THE PROBLEM. The path was reproducible with a mouse: create a resource leaving the opening balance empty (correct, there is nothing to record), then edit it and type the amount. The value ended up in storage and not in the accounts. From this version, editing posts the balance to the journal just as creating already did, and resources already in that state have a way out that did not exist before: re-saving them without changing the amount records them. The field locks after recording — rightly, the data now lives in the entry — and the form now says so beforehand, not at the next save.

THE SHORTCUT THAT MADE THE PROBLEM VANISH ALONG WITH THE MONEY. Until there was a way to record the opening, the only gesture that turned the badge green was deleting the resource: the entries stayed balanced, the liquidity disappeared, the check went green and nobody had fixed anything. Deletion is now refused with the reason and the remedy: a resource with movements is deactivated, one with an unrecorded opening balance must be recorded first. A resource created by mistake and never used deletes as always.

Fixed — THE DIAGNOSIS WAS BLIND TO HALF THE CASES: it looked for resources with a positive opening balance, while the calculation sums the negative ones too, so an overdrawn account caused an imbalance and fell into the «cause unknown» branch, the only one offering nothing to do. That branch now says what to look at — the equation in the details and the Debit/Credit totals in the panel next to it, which if they disagree point to a broken entry — instead of just deferring to the accountant. And opening entries have their own protocol prefix, APE: they fell into the generic SCR, which means «unclassified entry».

Under the hood: the outcome of the recording is now a type and not a boolean — six distinct cases, two of which are not errors and one of which stays an exception, because double entry that does not balance is a fault and not a state to narrate. The deletion ban lives on the model, in the shape already used by supplier invoices: a single guard that both decides and explains, so the two cannot diverge. Twenty-one new tests, including one that walks the whole cycle — the diagnosis names it, the button cures it, the diagnosis goes quiet — and the counter-proof that an empty resource still deletes.
